fact: On 21-22 October 2026 the Haut Conseil de la communication held a Bangui forum on responsible use of AI in the media, aiming to adopt a roadmap to frame AI use and curb hate speech, with the HCC saying it must act when legal limits are crossed.
title: Ouverture à Bangui du Forum national des médias sur l'éthique, la déontologie et sur l'utilisation responsable de l'IA
